steps: Title: used the previous arrow to find Ceasefire or Collapse, took office as Ukraine
Chose Guide me, closed the auto-opened briefing
Picked Accept in principle, saw YOUR PICK stamp, Execute
Then used Approve staff picks + Execute + Next month for 11 months
scenarios.notes: First satisfying result came about 2 minutes in (stamp plus debrief card), but the briefing panel and dense HUD came before it.

steps: Played Ukraine toward A peace that holds
Month 12: The war with Russia is over, Mission Complete grade B
scenarios.notes: I did not really choose most months; the staff did. The peace happened but I did not feel I made it happen.

friction.happened: globe keeps drifting, taps on pins missed twice; ended up using the small previous arrow
default is Hormuz Convoy (Iran, uranium, strait) which means nothing to me
extra screen before first month; I picked Guide me, which then opened a long briefing panel with Who is who, Why it matters, What really happened

Kramatorsk, Donetsk oblast, semi presidential, coalition of the willing, Rada, Pokrovsk axis, Legitimacy, Enerhodar, IAEA, Mission goals with numbers like UK relations 87 needs 93; none understood without the i
about 10 numbers and icons at the top plus a right rail of seals, orders, meetings, budgets; looks like work software
BACKFIRED label but the -10 is in green; unclear if good or bad
Approve staff picks made choices for me, such as Burn their refineries, which I never saw; mission bar dropped 60 to 51 under a step forward label
sometimes a Chronicle newspaper page with a different Next month button appeared, needing extra taps
Mission Complete and grade B, then Better than 9% of simulated competent leaders; felt like a put-down
Score 85 shown with red -15, par 102, Presidency score ladder, Statesman; confusing next to Mission Complete
a table of real-world text, nuclear program 100%, 1338k; I would skip it
tapped Share result, nothing visible happened except scroll

bugs.title: Share result gives no visible feedback
Backfired impact number shown in green
bugs.expected: red for a negative approval change

bugs.title: Presidency score counts from 0 slowly
bugs.actual: 0 / 1000 and 1 of 3 stars empty for several seconds

suggestions.what: Open the globe on a friendly default and stop drifting when I hover a pin
Skip the familiarity screen and the auto briefing; one small i is enough
Show 3 numbers at the top, hide the rest until I tap
Tell me what Approve staff picks chose before the month runs
End screen: lead with Mission Complete and stars, drop the percentile

delight: YOUR PICK stamp on a card, devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/olivia-laptop/012-m1d.png
Debrief card with a big number and illustration, devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/olivia-laptop/019-r2.png
The war with Russia is over scene, devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/olivia-laptop/041-f1.png

fun.reason: Cards, stamps and big numbers were nice; the reading load and staff autopilot kept it from being a toy.

clarity.reason: Many unknown names, a busy HUD and cryptic goals.

visual.reason: Illustrated cards, globe and badges look crafted.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Stamps and debriefs feel like a game, the top bar and rails feel like work software.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but staff picked for me and I could not see why mission numbers moved.

replay.reason: I won in one go and the rest felt like repeating buttons.

recommend.reason: Pretty, but I would tell a friend it is a lot of reading.

quit_point: About 90 seconds in, when the auto-opened briefing covered half the screen with Who is who and Why it matters before I had made a choice; I would have closed the tab if the cards behind it were not visible.
verbatim: It looks great, but who is Kramatorsk and why do I have 'Legitimacy'? I pressed Approve and Execute eleven times and then it said I had won. Nice. Then it told me I beat 9 percent of leaders. Rude.
